audit.summary: Four Major proof-dependency findings (P1,P2,P3,P5) and one Minor correction group (P4) in the 86-page ORA AAM. No counterexample to the principal theorem and no complete Type I/II repair claimed.
limitations: Joint prime-ideal constraints invalidate Lemma9.5 constant — Counterevidence: A rational-prime joint-factor reorganization may preserve intended cancellation; final Theorems1.1/4.1 not refuted.

Joint prime-ideal constraints invalidate Lemma9.5 constant — Counterevidence: Lemma 9.4 under its stated norm-coprime hypothesis is not disproved. Joint rational-prime grouping may retain intended cancellation; final Theorems 1.1/4.1 are not refuted.

TypeII restricted lattice index and minors-gcd truncation — Counterevidence: Nonzero g_b1*g_b2 and total weighted contribution were not established. D family not asserted to lie in every fixed fundamental domain/full support. Final scale inequalities are consistent.

TypeII restricted lattice index and minors-gcd truncation — Counterevidence: Nonzero sieve-weight product and the total weighted contribution are unverified. No counterexample to averaged Lemmas 11.5?11.7 or Proposition 9.14 is claimed; final scale constraints can be consistent.
Wrong upper exponent invalidates the core S1 saving — Counterevidence: No general infeasibility of proof parameters; replacement passes.

Wrong upper exponent invalidates the core S1 saving — Counterevidence: The explicit corrected constraints are feasible, so no general parameter incompatibility is established. A feasible repair does not validate the original core inference.
Cofactor discriminant formulas — Counterevidence: Correct formula preserves intended local zero tests, including distinct one-root branch; does not invalidate all downstream algebra.

Cofactor discriminant formulas — Counterevidence: The corrected algebra preserves the actual local zero tests. No subsequent division by t1 was found, and no tuple satisfying every asymptotic J/weight condition was established as a counterexample to Lemma8.1.

Incorrect asymptotic normalization in the Type I main term — Counterevidence: No final theorem constant counterexample from this typo. Formal finite g(mprime) cancellation possible after respecting coprimality, but P1 obstructs treating prime-local telescope as global repair.

Incorrect asymptotic normalization in the Type I main term — Counterevidence: Theorem4.1 itself already has the correct log(tauprime/tau), so this finding is not a false final-constant counterexample. Formal finite local factors may cancel after respecting exclusions.
